newsitem.title: USA: FPL Group hit with two $50,000 NRC fines.
newsitem.headline: FPL Group hit with two $50,000 NRC fines.

text.p: Florida Power & Light Co said the Nuclear Regulatory Commission proposed two $50,000 fines on the company for separate incidents at its St. Lucie nuclear plant.
The company said it does not plan to contest the fines, although it has 30 days to evaluate them.
The fines relate to unauthorized security access into the plant and failure to implement various aspects of the plant's emergency preparedness program, the company said.
The company also received a third notice -- relating to modifications to nuclear instrumentation -- that did not result in a fine, it said.
